name: Next Up Cleanup
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up, so the row only holds shows you are actually watching. Filters the server's response, changes no watch data.
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started.

versions.changelog: Initial release: filters the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up, on every client, without touching any watch data. Two modes - hide every S01E01, or keep the ones that already have a resume position or a play date. Requests are over-fetched and trimmed so the row stays as long as the client asked for.
